notes.title: 1.3.0 Release Notes
notes.content:
Get ready for a whole new racing experience! In our biggest update yet, we've completely revamped the gameplay to be more heart pumping than ever. You'll now be racing against other players to be the first to the finish line. This means you can go as fast (or slow) as you want, no more waiting for the camera to catch up with your rabbit.

Infinite Run is a new game mode with the original gameplay style and is available to Royal subscribers and 1/1 rabbit owners.

notes.title: King Rabbit - The Lord of the Rings
notes.content:
We're conducting a [url=https://www.discord.gg/kingrabbit]Discord community[/url] vote to determine the favorite King Rabbit Rings! Everyone who participates is eligible for some great prizes:

Round 1 - Oct 3 02:00 UTC - Oct 6 01:59 UTC - Uncommon Mushroom Ring
Round 2 - Oct 6 02:00 UTC - Oct 8 01:59 UTC - Rare Purple Gas Ring
Round 3 - Oct 8 02:00 UTC - Oct 10 01:59 UTC - Epic Cactus Ring
Round 4 - Oct 10 02:00 UTC - Oct 12 01:59 UTC - Legendary Plexus Ring
Round 5 - Oct 12 02:00 UTC - Oct 14 01:59 UTC - Mythic Rainbow Skull Ring
Round 6 - Oct 14 02:00 UTC - Oct 16 01:59 UTC - Perfect Matrix Ring

STEP 1: Go to [url=https://challonge.com/krrings]https://challonge.com/krrings[/url] to submit a prediction bracket for the community vote. Put as many of your wishes into it, but remember that the winning bracket will most accurately predict the way our Discord community votes.

STEP 2: Participate in voting in the [url=https://www.discord.gg/kingrabbit]King Rabbit Discord[/url] for each round, this starts on October 3 at 02:00 UTC. Voting dates listed above.

For each round, the moderators will select one matchup to give out a prize. Everyone who votes in that matchup will be eligible to win a prize. Only one win per user for Rounds 1-5. To be eligible for the final drawing (Matrix Ring), you must have voted in all five previous rounds while they were active.

notes.title: Playtesting open! Tap that wishlist button.
notes.content:
Get ready for nice, juicy update! We've made a ton of improvements and fixes to make King Rabbit more beautiful and performant than ever.

Please wishlist on our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1905900/King_Rabbit__Race/]Steam page[/url], this helps a lot!

[b]New[/b]
- Get your helmets ready, we now have quests that task you to run into specific items. Some items are easier to come by than others.
- The player banner at the top of the screen now shows your level and current progress towards the next level.
- Daily Challenge is now locked for new players until they reach level 3 (150 trophies)
- New players will now play through a simple tutorial to start their journey
- 3 more music tracks added, enjoy the new tunes 🎵

[b]Improved[/b]
- Opponents become more transparent when they get close (ring particles also fade out now)
- The kill zone at the bottom of the screen has been adjusted to give you a little more of a chance to come back
- Daily Challenge plays will now show the leaderboard instead of quests after the round (tap the leaderboard button to see quests)
- The time remaining until a new quest is now shown in the quests modal
- A "Search for friends" button has been added to the friends leaderboard
- The lava/water now has a nice animated texture
- There's now a sound played when sliding on ice
- The login/logout flow between user and guest accounts has been cleaned up
- Performance improvements to reduce stuttering while playing
- Various UI adjustments

[b]Fixed[/b]
- The starting platform no longer intersects with the first chunk (no more spikes showing up before the gate)
- Continue button not tappable on first try
- "GO!" text wrapping in some languages
- Ring sounds and particles not playing when dying
- Charm pits no longer use the skull skin in Puzzle
